parameters.content:
## 1. Voice intake
Vapi calls this webhook with the six fields the
**Client Onboarding Agent** collected.
The Code node flattens every Vapi payload shape
(tool call, end-of-call report, or flat test JSON).

## 2. AI processing
The LLM writes the service category, summary and
next action. The **priority is computed in code**
from the budget so the three required test calls
are 100% deterministic.

## 3. Fan out
Airtable = system of record.
Notion = the onboarding page + checklist.
Slack = priority-based team alert.

## 4. Priority-based alerts
HIGH -> HIGH PRIORITY CLIENT (+ @channel)
MEDIUM -> MEDIUM PRIORITY CLIENT
LOW -> STANDARD CLIENT
